column4: ~/proj/prompts/reports/SESSION-REVIEW-AUDITVERIFY-KEYFILES-1.md items 1 and 3. Findings fixed (red on main via redproof): AUDITVERIFY-STATE-ROW-IGNORED (medium: a DB-write actor who cut the tail and erased checkpoints, high-water and state row got VALID offline while the server reported a sticky discontinuity; offline now applies the server's deleted/garbled/past-head/recorded-discontinuity/head-gone rules and its saved-before-a-discontinuity rule (REVIEW-3810-DEEP-2, :TestReviewAV_VerifyStateRow_OlderRowPutBackOverDiscontinuity), accepting the row a pending key transition carries; internal/auditverify/review_adversarial_test.go:TestReviewAV_VerifyStateRow_* differential against core.AuditVerificationStatus), AUDITVERIFY-ROWS-OUTSIDE-WALK (low: id 0, NULL id or duplicate id on a batch boundary sat unverified; :TestReviewAV_RowsOutsideTheWalkAreBroken, :TestReviewAV_Postgres_IDZeroRowIsBroken), AUDITVERIFY-PREROTATION-ANCHOR (low: a supplied previous key never authenticated an --anchor exported before rotate-kek; :TestReviewAV_PreRotationAnchorAuthenticatedByPreviousKey), AUDITVERIFY-NOCHECKPOINT-NOTPROVEN (low, :TestReviewAV_NoCheckpointIsStatedNotProven), AUDITVERIFY-SQLITE-URI-PATH (low: a ? # or % in the path opened another file read-write; db_uri_path_test.go:TestOpenSQLiteReadOnly_PathWithURICharacters). Held: delete/reorder/modify/head truncation, forged or wrong-epoch transition records, zero and non-UTC event_time (hash uses UnixMicro), extra tables, valid chain after rotate-kek (:TestReviewAV_VerifyStateRow_KeyTransitionNotAFalseAlarm), real keyorix-server SQLite DB verifies VALID. Earlier targeted evidence carried forward (PR #2046, 2026-09-24): internal/auditverify/rowdecode_fuzz_test.go:FuzzAuditChainRowDecode on the raw-SQLite-file surface. Not covered: the crash window between key-file commit and completion reads BROKEN under the new key offline and online alike; the state row's failure (saved before a failure event), seal-count, unplaced-row and replay rules are not reimplemented (INV-AUDITVERIFY-verify-state-row-checked)
